responsibility: Defines the S/390-specific machine constraints consumed by GCC’s recog and reload machinery, covering register classes, immediate forms, vector constants, address forms, and memory-reference subclasses such as short/long displacement and literal-pool-sensitive operands. It is the canonical constraint table for the backend’s .md patterns and ties those textual constraint letters to helper predicates like s390_mem_constraint, s390_check_symref_alignment, and constant-shape tests.
